steps.note: S2.4.1 asserts that a forward invocation adds x_S to y_S for arbitrary scratch values (the lemma statement at 729), but never gives the net change (JV+RG)x or the reason it is independent of the scratch values: rows 6 and 7 restore them.

S2.4.3.1 says only that coefficients 'depend on the intersection size and side wires cancel the unwanted ones'; it gives neither the bit central coefficient |S cap T| mod 2, nor the cancellation of the intersection-one cases, nor the self coefficient one.
The complex central coefficient (|S cap T|-1)/2 and the cancellation of intersections zero and two appear nowhere; S2.4.3.1 names the cancellation without its content.
S2.4.1 states only the end result (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) with scratch restored; it omits the inverse middle stage X<-X-Y and the sequence (x,y)->(x,y+x)->(-y,y+x)->(-y,x).
S2.4.3.2 says every edge joins comparable nondegenerate labels, but the plan gives no per-edge orthogonal residuals or dimensions (the residual table).
The side edge 2->5, with t_X perp t_Y giving <t_X> in t_Y^perp and complement <t_X,t_Y>^perp of dimension h-2, is not mentioned.
S2.4.3.2 has the single decreasing center 3->4 edge losing h and the final Wm-2N+2L (the lemma statement at 998), but not the telescoping that gives it: source sum N, sink sum Wm-N, signed sum Wm-2N.
S2.4.3.5 uses orthonormal residual bases but never says why they exist: binary residuals are nondegenerate and nonalternating, and alternating planes are absorbed.
S2.4.3.3 states L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539 and supports it with the quote at line 1107.
Weight additivity mod 4 for orthogonal binary vectors, and the resulting q_V-q_U as a sum over an orthonormal basis, appear nowhere in the plan.

S2.4.3.5 asserts that each frame difference is a product of kernels aI+bX_v (the proposition at 1220), but not the derivation: odd weight gives the phase i^{eps[v.x]}, and H diag(1,-1) H = X turns it into a translation.

S2.6.1.2 states that each residual basis vector gives one tensored factor (C^{+-1})^{tensor f} across the f columns, and S2.6.1.3 that summing residual dimensions gives exactly s_c such calls; this matches the paper's k-column statement as used at 1878-1906.

The plan never gives the endpoint frames (I for the zero label, C^{tensor m} for the full label) or the C^{-1} on the 27 coordinates of supp(u_a) repaired by Z_{a,k} and i^{27k}Z_{a,k}, or the negated X outputs; S2.6.1.3 covers only the inverse-child identity.
S2.4.3.3 gives both ratios below 1/2, S2.4.3.4.3 the deficit N-2L_b>0, and S2.4.3.4 and S2.4.3.5 give s_b<W_b m and s_c<W_c m.
The value eta_b=339/22587335000000 is not stated; S2.4.4 only says the relative deficits exceed 20*2^-50.
The value eta_c=73/19906842167500 is not stated anywhere in the plan.
S2.4.4 states that both relative deficits exceed 20*2^-50 and log m<20, so tau=sigma=1-2^-50 gives s/W<m^tau for both networks; the explicit inequality m^{1-2^-50}>m(1-eta) is left implicit.

S2.4.5.1 states the factorization A=E_1 Pi E_2 with a ones (the lemma at 1366) but not the elimination proof: pivot at the topmost row's rightmost entry, lower-triangular clearing, repetition on the active indices.
The plan never mentions choosing a fixed odd prime that avoids all denominators, so that the rational identities specialize to Z/q^b with invertible triangular factors.

S2.4.5's motivation and method state that a lower-triangular coordinate change costs O(V) because controlled shifts update a later field from earlier fields; the descending update order is not stated explicitly.
S2.4.5.2 states that each one of Pi at (i,j) is done by D_j<-D_j+H_i, one interchange, then D_j<-H_i-D_j, so there are exactly a interchanges, citing line 1406.
S2.6.3.5 names the guard width ceil(C_0 d^{C_1}) without defining E, B, nu, C_1 or C_0.
The arithmetic-depth recurrence A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E with leaf bound 8e does not appear; S2.6.3.5 just asserts the guard width is o(p).
The unrolling B^{k+1}<=B^2 d^nu and A(e)<=8B^2 d^{nu+1}, with the total below C_0 d^{C_1}, is absent.

S2.6.3.5 asserts exactness and quotes 'Choose eps C_1<1' at 2582, but omits that depth l means values in 2^{-(p+l)}Z[i] of modulus at most 2^l, and the reservation of p+Delta fractional and Delta+3 integer bits.
S2.6.3.6 states the unit-disk output and the error below sqrt2 2^-p (the proposition at 2662) but not the reason: every row of the layer operator has absolute row sum one.

summary: P07 is present on 6 of 26 sub-steps (L5, P3, R1, R4, M3, M4). It mostly states lemma and proposition conclusions through quotes of their statements, without the paper's internal derivations: the bank-exchange coefficient and stage calculations, the residual table and telescoping, the phase-kernel derivation and endpoint repair, the elimination proof and prime choice, and the whole guard-width chain (S1-S5) are absent. No sub-step is stated contrary to the paper.
